theme_and_archetype.rationale: Meme coins require high energy, bold contrasts, and vibrant glowing elements to stand out. We are using a deep jungle black/green base mixed with neon green, cyan, and bright orange accents to create a 'radioactive jungle' feel appropriate for crypto.

layout_and_spacing.grid_strategy: Asymmetrical Tetris Grid for Tokenomics and About sections to keep the layout dynamic and playful. Heavy use of rounded corners (rounded-3xl) for all cards.

animations.background: tsparticles configured for floating jungle leaves (green/yellow/orange polygons or leaf SVGs)
animations.micro_interactions: Framer Motion hover scales (scale-105) on cards, continuous glowing drop-shadows on CTA buttons (drop-shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(57,255,20,0.6)])
animations.hero_mascot: Floating animation using framer-motion (animate={{ y: [-15, 15, -15] }}, transition={{ repeat: Infinity, duration: 4 }})

header.style: Glassmorphism sticky nav (backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#050B08]/60 border-b border-[#39FF14]/20)

hero.layout: 2-column on desktop. Left: Massive H1, Subtitle, CTA buttons (Buy & Chart), Contract Address copy box. Right: Floating Sloth Mascot.
hero.special: Marquee banner below hero running '$FLASH - LITTLE FLASH - THE FASTEST SLOTH IN CRYPTO' using react-fast-marquee

chart_section.style: Large bento container with glowing green border and subtle inner glow.

about_section.style: Dark green translucent cards with neon orange accents.

token_info.layout: Bento Grid (Total Supply, Tax, LP Burned).
token_info.interactive: Click-to-copy Contract Address box with Sonner toast notification.

roadmap.layout: Vertical glowing timeline or 4-column card grid.
phases: Phase 1: The Awakening (Launch, DEX Listing, Socials)
Phase 4: Sloth Speed (Utility Rollout, Global Takeover)

meme_gallery.layout: CSS Grid (Columns: 1 mobile, 2 tablet, 3 desktop) with Framer Motion Lightbox on click.
meme_gallery.hover: Images scale up slightly and border glows on hover.

footer.style: Massive typography '$FLASH', social icon links (Twitter, Telegram), disclaimer text. Very generous top padding (pt-32).

instructions_to_main_agent: Create the app purely using functional React components (.jsx / .js, NO .tsx).
Use Tailwind CSS for all styling. Ensure colors match the provided hex codes in this JSON.
Install `@studio-freight/react-lenis` or `lenis` for smooth scrolling in the main layout wrapper.
Install and use `framer-motion` for scroll reveal animations, the lightbox gallery, and the floating mascot.
Install and use `react-fast-marquee` for a continuous scrolling ticker.
Install `lucide-react` for standard UI and social icons.
Install `sonner` for the copy-to-clipboard success toast on the contract address.
Install `react-tsparticles` and `tsparticles` for the floating jungle leaves background. Use slow moving, glowing green/orange particles.
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='buy-button', data-testid='copy-ca-button', data-testid='nav-link-about', data-testid='gallery-image').
Make the main Buy Buttons heavily animated with a continuous pulsing drop-shadow to emphasize the call to action.
Include the Dexscreener iframe. Use `https://dexscreener.com/solana/` as the base, use a placeholder solana pair if needed.
Implement a simple state-based lightbox for the Meme Gallery so clicking an image expands it in a modal over the UI.
No backend code is required. All data (roadmap, tokenomics) should be hardcoded in the frontend components.
